# Burnly v0.1.29

Repairs the OpenCode 2 and Antigravity compatibility failures that could leave
refreshes partial after upgrading to v0.1.28.

## Highlights

- **OpenCode 2 error-envelope recovery.** Assistant error records that contain
  lifecycle and model metadata but no token payload no longer abort the entire
  OpenCode collection. Burnly preserves the session's authoritative cumulative
  counters and records the missing exact attribution as partial data.
- **Strict malformed-data handling.** Only structured OpenCode 2 error records
  with every usage field absent use this recovery path. Mixed, negative, or
  otherwise malformed usage payloads remain incompatible instead of being
  silently accepted.
- **Antigravity legacy artifact routing.** Legacy `.pb` conversations remain
  discoverable for runtime collection but are no longer opened as SQLite
  databases. Valid `.db` failures still prevent an incomplete full baseline.
- **Automatic health recovery.** The schema-12 upgrade removes only the
  obsolete compatibility warnings produced by these v0.1.28 bugs. Other
  collector failures, invalid locations, and malformed diagnostics remain
  visible.

## Privacy

The fixes continue to read usage-only metadata. Burnly does not load OpenCode
prompt or response content, and Antigravity reconciliation does not load
prompt-bearing conversation content. Upgrade cleanup targets bounded diagnostic
codes and source identities rather than source payloads.

## Install

### Linux

Run:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/latest/download/install-linux.sh | sh
```

For a pinned install of this release:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/download/v0.1.29/install-linux.sh | BURNLY_VERSION=v0.1.29 sh
```

### Windows Preview

Download the Windows x64 installer from this release:

```text
burnly-v0.1.29-windows-x86_64.exe
```

The Windows preview installer is not Authenticode-signed. Windows may show an
unknown publisher or SmartScreen warning. Only download Burnly from the
official GitHub release and verify the published `SHA256SUMS`. Tauri updater
artifacts remain cryptographically signed.

### macOS Preview

Run:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/latest/download/install-macos.sh | sh
```

For a pinned install of this release:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/download/v0.1.29/install-macos.sh | BURNLY_VERSION=v0.1.29 sh
```

Manual `.dmg` installation is also available:

```text
burnly-v0.1.29-macos-aarch64.dmg
burnly-v0.1.29-macos-x86_64.dmg
```

The macOS preview is unsigned and not notarized. If Gatekeeper blocks the
downloaded app, clear quarantine once after copying it to Applications:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Burnly.app
```

## Verification

The repaired collectors were exercised against active local OpenCode and
Antigravity installations with disposable Burnly databases. OpenCode reached
stable complete daily and session results, while Antigravity processed all 216
discovered artifacts and produced matching complete daily/session totals
without an incomplete-baseline warning.

Release artifacts include `SHA256SUMS`, GitHub build provenance, signed updater
artifacts, `latest.json`, and the `latest-linux.json` compatibility alias.
